themes.mechanism: Light default; dark stored as appchi-theme in localStorage and applied as data-theme on <html> before first paint. Dark values are the *-dark colour tokens.
themes.keycloak: keycloak/themes/appchi/login/resources/css/appchi.css mirrors the palette through light-dark() --ap-* tokens.

exceptions: Refreshing tables dim to 0.62 opacity (.is-stale): muted/subtle drop to about 2.6-3.9:1 while the refetch is in flight.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ocean blue fill for the one primary action of a view, including Save and Run.
components.css: .ds-btn { height: 34px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--input-border, #c9d8e6); background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: var(--text, #0e1b2a); font: 500 13px/1 var(--font-geist, Geist), system-ui, sans-serif; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-p { background: var(--primary, #0a6fb0); border-color: var(--primary, #0a6fb0); color: var(--primary-text, #ffffff); } .ds-btn-p:hover { background: var(--primary-hover, #085c93); border-color: var(--primary-hover, #085c93); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #0a6fb0); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.css: .ds-cel { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; height: 36px; padding: 0 4px 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--input-border, #c9d8e6); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: var(--muted, #4e6176); font-family: var(--font-geist, Geist), system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-cel:focus-within { border-color: var(--focus, #0a6fb0); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--focus-ring, #cfe5f6); } .ds-cel-q { flex: 1; color: var(--text, #0e1b2a); font: 12.5px/21px var(--font-geist-mono, 'Geist Mono'), ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-cel-help { font-size: 10px; color: var(--subtle, #56697e); } .ds-cel-run { height: 26px; padding: 0 11px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--primary, #0a6fb0); background: var(--primary, #0a6fb0); color: var(--primary-text, #ffffff); font: 500 12.5px/1 var(--font-geist, Geist), system-ui, sans-serif; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-cel-run:hover { background: var(--primary-hover, #085c93); } .ds-cel-run:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #0a6fb0); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-cel-kbd { font: 600 10.5px/1 var(--font-geist-mono, 'Geist Mono'), ui-monospace, monospace; opacity: 0.9; }

components.css: .ds-qvs { display: flex; gap: 4px; font-family: var(--font-geist, Geist), system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-qv { all: unset; cursor: pointer; height: 34px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 8px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font: 500 13px/1 var(--font-geist, Geist), system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink-soft, #3a4e63); } .ds-qv:hover { background: var(--line, #ebf1f7); } .ds-qv-on, .ds-qv-on:hover { background: var(--primary-soft, #ddeefa); color: var(--accent, #075e96); } .ds-qv:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #0a6fb0); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-m-crit { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--critical-mark, #d92d20); } .ds-m-high { width: 8px; height: 8px; background: var(--high-mark, #ec6a13); transform: rotate(45deg); } .ds-m-warn { width: 6px; height: 6px; border: 2px solid var(--amber-mark, #d99a06); border-radius: 50%; }

narrative.overview:
Appchi is an Operate surface: operators work it at desk monitors through a shift, and dashboards also run fullscreen on NOC wall displays read from across the room. The system as built is the incumbent Appchi workspace (structure of commit `f58c7d0`) recoloured with the user-chosen Ocean palette on 2026-10-26. Nothing moved: the same 76px icon rail, crumb-and-title page header, CEL bar, quick views, white table panels, Geist and Geist Mono, 8px controls and 12px panels. What changed is temperature. The shell reads as a cool blue tint instead of warm grey, and the blue marks exactly two things: where to act and where you are.

Density is moderate and even. Body text is 13.5px, rows are 48–52px, panels are flat white cards with a hairline border on a faintly blue canvas. Colour is semantic, not decorative: every colour in the feature styles resolves to one role in `src/app/theme.css`, defined once for light (the default) and once for dark. Status and severity keep their red, orange, amber and green meanings, tuned to sit inside the palette, and each severity pairs a readable text colour with a shape-coded mark.

The confirmed rejections come from the user: no black-and-white or grayscale palette, no black primary buttons, no generic SaaS admin look, no neon hacker console, no playful consumer styling, and nothing structural from the Ocean prototype (no 228px labelled sidebar, no Mulish or IBM Plex Mono, no halo on firing dots, none of its spacing or size changes).
keyCharacteristics: Incumbent structure, Ocean colour: cool blue-tinted rail and canvas, white panels, navy ink.
One solid blue for primary actions, Run, the active rail tile, the brand mark and the selected tab underline; a soft blue pill for the selected quick view.
Semantic roles only, light and dark, each text role at 4.5:1 or better on its surfaces.
Flat bordered panels at rest; navy-tinted shadows only on things that float.
Geist for interface text, Geist Mono for CEL, timestamps, source lines and board counts.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Solid Ocean blue means "act here" or "you are here": primary buttons, Run, the active rail tile, the brand mark, the selected tab underline and focus. A selected filter is the soft `primary-soft` pill, never the solid fill, and blue is never used as decoration.

rules.name: The Roles Only Rule
rules.body: Every colour in feature styles is a `var(--role)` from `src/app/theme.css`, and each role is defined exactly twice, once for light and once for dark. No raw hex or rgba appears outside the token layer; shadows are built from `--shadow-rgb` and `--shade-*`.

rules.name: The 4.5 Floor Rule
rules.body: Every text role meets 4.5:1 on the surfaces it is used on, in both themes, placeholders included (`subtle` is 5.65:1 on white and 6.66:1 on dark panels). The Run button's Ctrl+Enter hint renders at 0.9 opacity and still measures 4.67:1 in light and 6.99:1 in dark.

rules.name: The Mono-for-Machine Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono is reserved for CEL, timestamps and source sub-lines, filter chips and board counts. Everything a person reads as interface copy is Geist. Counts and paging numbers use tabular figures.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces never carry a shadow. A shadow means the object floats (popover, menu, bulk bar, dialog) or is the selected thumb of a control.

dos: **Do** take every colour from a `src/app/theme.css` role and define any new role once for light and once for dark.
**Do** keep text roles at 4.5:1 or better on their surfaces in both themes, placeholders included.
**Do** use solid Ocean blue (`primary`) only for the primary action, Run, the current rail tile, the brand mark, the selected tab underline and focus.
**Do** show a selected filter or quick view as the soft blue pill (`primary-soft` with `accent` text).
**Do** pair each severity's text colour with its shape-coded mark so meaning never rests on hue alone.
**Do** keep resting panels flat (12px radius, 1px `border`, no shadow) and reserve navy-tinted shadows for floating objects.
**Do** use Geist Mono for CEL, timestamps, source sub-lines and counts, with tabular figures for numbers.
donts: **Don't** use black primary buttons or a black-and-white or grayscale palette; the user superseded them with Ocean.
**Don't** adopt the Ocean prototype's structure: no 228px labelled sidebar, no Mulish or IBM Plex Mono, no halo on firing dots, no Ocean spacing or size changes.
**Don't** write raw hex or rgba in feature styles.
**Don't** add coloured accent borders to cards other than threshold count panels.
**Don't** add eyebrow or kicker labels above page titles; the header is crumb row, title and subtitle.
**Don't** treat the "A" square as a finished logo.
